description: EF Core objects never cross a process or language boundary. The C++ side sends this JSON DTO; the C# side maps it to EF Core entities. 'payload' is the BOD noun converted generically (XML element -> JSON property, repeated elements -> array, attributes -> '@name'). Replace/extend the typed mapping on both sides to plug in a real noun.

bodId.description: ApplicationArea/BODID if present, else a client-generated id

nounType.description: Second element under DataArea, e.g. InventoryItem

payload.description: The noun element, converted generically to JSON

verb.description: First element under DataArea, e.g. Process / Sync / Get

title: BodTransportDto - the ONLY thing that crosses the HTTPS wire
